scripts.install-all: bun install && cd frontend && bun install
scripts.deploy:local: bunx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Voting.js --network localhost
scripts.deploy:local-reset: bunx hardhat ignition deploy ignition/modules/Voting.js --network localhost --reset
scripts.deploy:sepolia: bun run validate && NODE_ENV=production bunx hardhat run scripts/deploy-simple.js --network sepolia
scripts.deploy:sepolia-verify: bun run validate && NODE_ENV=production bunx hardhat run scripts/deploy-simple.js --network sepolia && bunx hardhat verify --network sepolia
scripts.deploy:mainnet: bun run validate && NODE_ENV=production bunx hardhat run scripts/deploy-simple.js --network mainnet
scripts.dev: concurrently "bun run server" "cd frontend && bun run dev"
scripts.build: bun run compile && cd frontend && bun run build
